mapper.sql: id, appointment_id, patient_id, doctor_id, chief_complaint, symptoms, temperature_c, pulse_bpm, bp_systolic, bp_diastolic, weight_kg, diagnosis, doctor_notes, advice, follow_up_date, status, completed_at, dispense_status, dispensed_by, dispensed_at, dispense_remarks, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultations (appointment_id, patient_id, doctor_id, chief_complaint, symptoms, temperature_c, pulse_bpm, bp_systolic, bp_diastolic, weight_kg, diagnosis, doctor_notes, advice, follow_up_date, status) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{symptoms}, #{temperatureC}, #{pulseBpm}, #{bpSystolic}, #{bpDiastolic}, #{weightKg}, #{diagnosis}, #{doctorNotes}, #{advice}, #{followUpDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE consultations SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, dispense_status = #{dispenseStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, consultation_id, medicine_name, strength, dosage_pattern, timing, duration_days, instructions, display_order FROM prescription_items WHERE consultation_id = #{consultationId} ORDER BY display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription_items (consultation_id, medicine_name, strength, dosage_pattern, timing, duration_days, instructions, display_order) VALUES (#{consultationId}, #{medicineName}, #{strength}, #{dosagePattern}, #{timing}, #{durationDays}, #{instructions}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS consultationId, a.appointment_date AS date, doc.full_name AS doctorName, c.diagnosis AS diagnosis, c.advice AS advice, c.follow_up_date AS followUpDate, c.temperature_c AS temperatureC, c.pulse_bpm AS pulseBpm, c.bp_systolic AS bpSystolic, c.bp_diastolic AS bpDiastolic, c.weight_kg AS weightKg, c.dispense_status AS dispenseStatus, c.dispensed_at AS dispensedAt, c.dispense_remarks AS dispenseRemarks FROM consultations c JOIN appointments a ON a.id = c.appointment_id JOIN doctors doc ON doc.id = c.doctor_id WHERE c.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND c.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT c.id AS consultationId, a.appointment_date AS date, doc.full_name AS doctorName, dept.dept_name AS departmentName, c.diagnosis AS diagnosis, c.advice AS advice, c.doctor_notes AS doctorNotes, c.dispense_status AS dispenseStatus, c.dispensed_at AS dispensedAt, c.dispense_remarks AS dispenseRemarks FROM consultations c JOIN appointments a ON a.id = c.appointment_id JOIN doctors doc ON doc.id = c.doctor_id JOIN departments dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id WHERE c.patient_id = #{patientId} AND c.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC, c.id DESC
